title: Delaware History (5th Grade)
description: Delaware History (5th Grade) practice - 100 questions. questions.question: Long before Europeans arrived, the main Native people living in the Delaware River valley were the:
questions.correctAnswer: Lenape, also called the Delaware Indians
distractors: Nanticoke only, who lived alone in the whole valley
Iroquois, who built longhouses along the bay
questions.explanation: The Lenape lived for thousands of years in the Delaware River valley and along Delaware Bay. Europeans later called them the Delaware Indians, after the river and bay.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Lenape first - the valley's first people.

To escape paying taxes to a king
Because their houses wore out each season
questions.explanation: Lenape life followed the seasons: spring fish runs, summer gardens, fall harvests and nut gathering, and winter hunting. Families moved between villages and camps to be where the food was.
